```{ojs}
//| output: false
import {makePortal} from "../assets/portal.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
P        = makePortal({d3, Inputs, html, DOM})
projects = P.parseProjects(await FileAttachment("../_generated/projects_overview.csv").csv())
dtMeta   = P.loadDatatypeMeta([...new Set(projects.flatMap(p => p.datatypes))], "../")
dtName   = id => dtMeta.get(id)?.name ?? id
```
